  --resource-group rg-ai901 --kind AIServices --sku S0 \
  --location eastus --custom-domain contoso-ai \
  --assign-identity --allow-project-management true
az cognitiveservices account project create \
  --name contoso-ai --resource-group rg-ai901 \
  --project-name study --location eastus

  --name contoso-ai --resource-group rg-ai901 \
  --deployment-name chat-prod --model-name gpt-5-mini \
  --model-version "2025-08-07" --model-format OpenAI \

  --assignee "user@contoso.com" --scope $PROJECT_ID

snippets.title: Connect
snippets.code:
# pip install "azure-ai-projects>=2.3.0" azure-identity
# endpoint: https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com
#           /api/projects/<project>
project = AIProjectClient(
    endpoint=ENDPOINT, credential=DefaultAzureCredential())
openai = project.get_openai_client()

r = openai.responses.create(
    model="chat-prod", instructions="Be brief.", input="Hi")
r2 = openai.responses.create(
    model="chat-prod", input="And now?", previous_response_id=r.id)
print(r2.output_text)

snippets.title: Chat Completions
snippets.code:
messages = [{"role": "system", "content": "Be brief."},
            {"role": "user", "content": "Hi"}]
r = openai.chat.completions.create(
    model="chat-prod", messages=messages)
answer = r.choices[0].message.content
messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": answer})

title.en: Create a version with file search

snippets.code:
store = openai.vector_stores.create(name="policies")
openai.vector_stores.files.upload_and_poll(
    vector_store_id=store.id, file=open("policy.md", "rb"))
project.agents.create_version(
    agent_name="hr-helper",
    definition=PromptAgentDefinition(
        model="chat-prod", instructions="Answer from the files.",
        tools=[FileSearchTool(vector_store_ids=[store.id])]))

openai = project.get_openai_client(agent_name="hr-helper")
conversation = openai.conversations.create()
r = openai.responses.create(
    conversation=conversation.id, input="How many holidays?")
print(r.output_text)
openai.conversations.delete(conversation_id=conversation.id)
